verdict.caution: This is 6 horizons x two directions on the SAME 4 trajectories and is not 12 independent successes; nor are the 72 governing cells 72 independent tests. No P-value attaches to any count here and none is computed. The three Arm A seeds share training data and differ only in initialisation and data ordering, so they are not three independent models. The two models differ on several axes at once — training data, recipe, iteration count, and a released-checkpoint provenance S-19 records as not fully reconstructible — so this bounds transfer between these two models and is not an attribution.
